title: What's new in Expense Agent: Overview (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Web App Refresh and Language Support
Travel Requests and Expense Report Creation
Withholding Tax for Employees and Closing Remarks

features.name: Improved Mileage Handling with Period-Based Rates
features.description: Users can now configure mileage allowances per different periods, allowing for changes across years. System automatically applies the correct rate based on expense date.
caveats: Customers can use a simple model without setting up periods if preferred
A separate session covers mileage in detail

features.name: Vehicle Type-Specific Mileage Rates
features.description: Users can define different mileage allowances for different vehicle types such as car, truck, SUV, and motorcycle, combined with date ranges.
caveats: Complexity is optional; simple setup available for customers who do not need this

features.name: Credit Card Feeds Manual Upload
features.description: Users can manually upload credit card statements which the system processes and reconciles with expenses. Automatically reconciles credit card records with existing expenses.
features.status_evidence_quote: it will not be available from October, it will be available from December, so 2029.2.
caveats: Available from December 2029.2, not October 2026
First release; features expand in later releases

features.name: Reactive Credit Card Expense Creation
features.description: If receipts are not scanned in advance, system automatically creates expenses from credit card records. Users must later attach receipts before submitting.
caveats: Receipts must be attached before expense submission
Applies when expenses are created after credit card statement upload

features.name: Proactive Credit Card Reconciliation
features.description: If receipts are scanned in advance, system automatically reconciles credit card records with existing expenses in the background without user intervention.
caveats: Only applies when receipts are scanned prior to credit card upload
Reconciliation is automatic based on which comes first

features.name: AI-Driven Travel Expense Policy Compliance
features.description: System automatically checks all expenses against configured travel policies using AI. Policies are human-readable text covering flight classes, upgrades, and private aircraft usage.
caveats: Requires enabling policy compliance which incurs additional AI costs
Flagged items are not hard limitations; approvers can override
Separate session covers details and demonstrations

features.name: Policy Flagging for Non-Compliant Expenses
features.description: System flags expenses that do not comply with configured policies, such as missing flight class specification, to help approvers make informed decisions without hard blocking.
caveats: Flagged items do not prevent approval; approvers can approve non-compliant expenses

features.name: Enhanced Approval History and Audit Trail
features.description: Expense approvals now include detailed approval history and audit trail to provide transparency in the approval process.
features.status_evidence_quote: it will come gradually from October to December, but all these features will be in next 2 months.
caveats: Details shown in separate session

features.name: Interim Approvers and Delegate Approvals
features.description: Approval workflow now supports interim approvers, specification of approval limits, and alternate delegate approvals.
features.status_evidence_quote: it will come gradually from October to December, but all these features will be in next 2 months.
caveats: Gradual rollout from October to December

features.name: Travel Requests
features.description: New functionality allowing users to create travel requests for specific trips (e.g., conferences) that go through approval. When approved, system automatically creates an expense report and assigns all trip-related receipts to it.
features.status_evidence_quote: it will come gradually from October to December, but all these features will be in next 2 months.
caveats: Completely new functionality
Separate session covers details
Gradual rollout from October to December

features.name: Automatic Travel Expense Assignment
features.description: System automatically assigns all receipts and expenses specified for a particular trip to the corresponding expense report created from the travel request.

features.name: New Mobile App with Offline Support
features.description: New mobile app (available on iPhone and Android) allows users to scan receipts. System automatically crops receipts from background and works in offline mode, processing receipts when internet becomes available.
features.status_evidence_quote: this is available right now in a preview. So, only for testing, but this is this is available.
caveats: Currently in preview for testing only
Works on both iPhone and Android
Separate session covers details

features.name: VAT Reclaim in Expense Reports
features.description: Users can now claim VAT in expense reports. System automatically identifies and collects VAT details from receipts and prepares VAT specifications per line. Requires enabling VAT reclaim in agent setup.
caveats: Not fully automated; accountants must review and confirm
Rules vary by country; some countries do not allow VAT reclaim via expense reports
VAT only identified from receipts from user's home country
Multiple VAT rates can apply to a single line item
Manual setup required in expense categories and subcategories

features.name: VAT Specification per Expense Line
features.description: VAT is tracked and reported per expense line rather than per document, allowing for multiple VAT rates per line item (e.g., different rates for breakfast and room in a hotel bill).
caveats: Applies when VAT reclaim is enabled

features.name: Withholding Tax for Employees
features.description: Extension of withholding tax to employees for expense reports. System supports gross/net and compound models. Withholding tax is applied based on thresholds and posting groups configured for employees and expense categories.
caveats: Applicable only in countries where withholding tax on per diem or allowances is required
Requires setup of withholding tax posting groups and assignment to employees and categories
Separate session covers details

features.name: Refreshed Web App User Experience
features.description: Business Central Expense Agent web app has been refreshed with a new user interface that displays details upfront.

features.name: Expanded Language Support
features.description: Expense Agent language support expanded to include Czech, Dutch, Icelandic, Italian, Norwegian, and Swedish in addition to existing languages.
caveats: Currently five languages enabled; new languages added with this release

features.name: Worldwide Availability Rollout
features.description: Expense Agent worldwide availability enablement beginning October with gradual expansion to all countries within the next few months.
caveats: Gradual rollout from October; not all countries available on day one
Expansion expected within a few months of October launch
